title: Unraveling a Potential Connection Between Bilirubin Metabolism, Gut Microbiota and Inflammatory Bowel Diseases
brief_summary: Inflammatory Bowel Diseases (IBDs) are a set of recurrent inflammatory conditions that include the colon and small intestine. The two principal conditions include Crohn's disease (CD) and ulcerative colitis (UC). The etiology of which is likely to stem from the interplay of gut microbial imbalances and host. In this study stool cultures, saliva and skin samples will be taken from all participants.
